technology.value: Node.js (Express) backend with Apollo Server (GraphQL); Vue 2.6 + Vuetify single-page front end. Wiki.js v2.

run_command.value: Docker image `ghcr.io/requarks/wiki:2` (aka requarks/wiki) against a database (PostgreSQL/MySQL/etc.); or `node server` after `yarn build`. Reads config.yml (copy config.sample.yml).
run_command.evidence: no Dockerfile in mirror clone - confirm image tag/run at eval authoring time

host.evidence: config.sample.yml `port: 3000` ("Port the server should listen to").

api_style.value: GraphQL. Endpoint /graphql served by apollo-server-express; schema in server/graph/schemas/*.graphql.
api_style.evidence: server/graph/schemas/*.graphql (user, comment, asset, navigation, group...); apollo-server-express dependency.

spa.value: yes - Vue 2.6 + Vuetify client-rendered front end.

auth.value: required for admin and most write actions. Local username/password login (form/session, JWT) plus many OAuth/SSO strategies (Auth0, Azure, GitHub, Google, GitLab, etc.). Public read access is configurable per-instance.
auth.evidence: server/modules/authentication/ contains local plus auth0, azure, github, google, gitlab, ... strategies.
